api.auth.authentication_required: 401 when a request has no valid cookie session or bearer credential.
api.auth.csrf_invalid: 403 when a cookie-authenticated mutation sends no or a wrong CSRF token.
api.auth.invalid_credentials: 401 when a login attempt fails; never names the failing check.
api.auth.origin_not_allowed: 403 when a cookie-authenticated request comes from another origin.
api.auth.too_many_attempts: 429 when the login throttle window is exhausted.
api.error.bad_request: Generic 400 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.conflict: Generic 409 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.forbidden: Generic 403 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.http_error: Generic envelope text for an HTTP error whose detail is not text.
api.error.internal_error: 500 envelope text for an unhandled exception.
api.error.method_not_allowed: Generic 405 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.not_found: Generic 404 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.too_many_requests: Generic 429 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.unauthorized: Generic 401 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.unavailable: Generic 503 envelope text for HTTP errors without a domain key.
api.error.validation_error: Top-level 422 envelope message; details carry the per-field keys.
api.i18n.invalid_currency: 422 when installation settings send a currency Babel does not know.
api.i18n.invalid_timezone: 422 when installation settings send an unknown IANA time zone.
api.i18n.locale_count: Plural example and translator tooling for the number of installed languages.
api.i18n.text_unavailable: Shown instead of a raw key when a catalog entry is missing.
api.i18n.unknown_doc_topic: 404 when an authenticated docs request has no localized topic for the requested locale chain.
api.i18n.unknown_locale: 422/404 when a requested or configured language is not installed.
